title: setup hook --yes creates .claude/settings.json with the JITSO guard on PreToolUse (Bash and the orca MCP tools) and SessionEnd
source: intended: docs/decisions.md D8 (setup hook, defect N-17): jitso registers its guard in the project's .claude/settings.json without clobbering anything
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-17, setup hook). In a project with no `.claude/settings.json`, `jitso setup hook --yes` writes the canonical file (2-space indent, trailing newline): two JITSO groups under PreToolUse (matchers `Bash` and `mcp__.*orca.*__.*`) and one without matcher under SessionEnd, each with the bare command `jitso hook guard`. stdout prints the preview, `created .claude/settings.json`, a `note:` that the untracked file must be committed, and `jitso setup hook: done`. The bare word is not on the sandbox PATH, so a warning goes to stderr; the write still happens.

stdout: note: commit .claude/settings.json so linked worktrees and other clones get the guard
stderr: jitso: warning: jitso is not on PATH, so the hook cannot start until it is (the guard then lets every call through)
